summary: Pearson plc filed a Form 6-K with a TR-1 notification of major holdings. Artisan Partners Limited Partnership disclosed crossing a threshold to 11.01% voting rights (66,909,195 shares) as of April 21, 2026, up from a prior 10.11% position. The filing is a routine beneficial ownership update required under UK disclosure rules, with no board recommendation, advisory roles, or event-driven transaction terms. No price, premium, or strategic action is stated. This is a passive stake increase, not a special situation; watch for any future activist intentions or tender offers but currently routine.
